verdict.rationale: Groq is an inference platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at console.groq.com/docs/mcp. The remote-MCP docs describe Groq consuming external MCP servers, which is client-side and not credited here. Missing for 10: details of the server's tools, setup or auth flow, transport and hosting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to it.
